principle: A linter asks whether the CSS is valid. A design lead asks whether the page was DESIGNED. The tells of an undesigned page are countable: too many type sizes, too many near-identical greys, an accent used everywhere so it accents nothing.
blindSpot: It cannot SEE. It counts and measures. It cannot tell you a page is ugly, only that the choices behind it were not made deliberately.

findings.why: Beyond a dozen, the palette stops being a palette. Most of the extras are near-duplicate greys nobody chose on purpose.
findings.fix: Reduce to tokens. If two greys differ by less than 6% luminance, they are one grey.

findings.why: WCAG AA wants 4.5:1 for body text and 3:1 for large text. Below 3 it is unreadable on a phone in daylight, which is where this is actually seen.
findings.fix: Lighten --faint until it clears 4.5, or reserve it for text at 18px and above.

findings.what: remote fonts with no local fallback
findings.why: On a slow connection the page renders in the browser default, which is Times. First impressions do not get a second attempt.
findings.fix: Add system-ui and a generic family to every font stack.

findings.why: An accent used everywhere accents nothing, and it is the most common reason a dark page reads as cheap rather than considered.
findings.fix: Spend it in two places: the active state and the one primary action. Everything else greys.

findings.fix: Either give it a generator or delete it. A page nothing owns cannot be maintained.

findings.what: 1 of 35 cards use no brand typeface
findings.why: A card in the system default is a card that could have come from anywhere. The typeface is most of what makes it ours at a glance.
findings.fix: Set Syne, Sora or JetBrains Mono on every text element.

handoff.designer: counts and measures. Cannot see anything rendered.
handoff.cc: sees the rendered page and real browser behaviour. Cannot reason about what produced it.
handoff.chat: reads the code and knows what generated what. Cannot see a single pixel.
handoff.tyler: taste, which none of the three approximates.
handoff.protocol: The designer asks; CC answers from screenshots by writing answeredBy and answer back into forEyes; chat fixes at the generator. A question with an answer is never asked again.
